items.title: Balance Update 2.1.3
items.body:
Hey again! A week has passed and we are now presenting a new balance update. Along with it, a new set of skins and the comeback of a loved limited-time ladder event, one that allows you to get special custom ranks.

To celebrate Black Friday, we're launching the second edition of our Ladder Event, featuring five exclusive Custom Ranks inspired by Itachi, Hidan, Shisui, Orochimaru, and Kisame!
These exclusive cosmetics can be obtained by completing the new temporary Ladder Missions or directly through our Patreon. Additionally, Custom Ranks from the previous Ladder Event will return exclusively through Patreon, at a higher price.
The Ladder Event and its temporary missions will remain available until December 23rd, 2026. Once the event ends, these exclusive Custom Ranks will no longer be obtainable through missions.
Reminder: If you reset your account before completing a mission, all progress toward that mission will also be reset.

New Skin Set: Disguising Tactics - Master the art of deception and catch your enemies off guard with the new Disguising Tactics Skin Set!

Painter - Uzumaki Naruto
Fake ANBU Member - Yakushi Kabuto
Sukea - Hatake Kakashi
Genyuumaru - Orochimaru

We're releasing a new Tsunade (S). That's the character you'll have unlocked if you already had completed Tsunade (S)'s mission. There's a new mission for Shinobi Alliance Tsunade (S); we are aware it can be frustrating to re-unlock a set of skills you already had, but think of it as you getting a completely new character instantly in exchange.

As the Fifth Hokage and one of the Legendary Sannin, Tsunade possesses extraordinary physical strength and unparalleled medical ninjutsu. By combining her devastating attacks with Katsuyu's healing abilities and her mastery of chakra control, she protects her allies while overwhelming her enemies on the battlefield.

Haruno Sakura (S) got completely reworked, as we aim to make her more straight-forward, useful, and also increase the amount of different chakra types you can use to heal your team.

With her extensive training under Tsunade, the Godaime, for the last two and a half years, Sakura(s)'s healing and combat abilities have both greatly improved.
Balances: 
Boosts: Umino Iruka, Temari (S), Deva Path Pein (S).
Nerfs: Namikaze Minato, Mangekyou Sasuke (S), Shinobi Alliance Kiba (S), Shinobi Alliance Mei (S), Edo Tensei Pakura (S), Sennin Kabuto (S).

items.title: Balance Update 2.1.2
items.body:
Hey there y'all! It's time for a refreshing balance update so we can try and make the characters more aligned with each other. We're also adding a new skin set, with missions and also Patreon Purchase, along with some bug fixes while we are at it.

New Skin Set: Battle-Damaged - Battle scars tell stories of survival. Return to the battlefield with the Battle-Damaged skins and prove that even the toughest fights can't break your spirit!

Battle-Damaged Zabuza - Momochi Zabuza
Battle-Damaged Sakura - Haruno Sakura (S)
Battle-Damaged Itachi - Uchiha Itachi (S)
Battle-Damaged Tobi - Tobi (S)
Battle-Damaged Konan - Konan of the Rain (S)

See you soon!
Bug Fixes and General Changes:

Shinobi War Tobi (S)'s 'Six Paths Connection' now clarifies that the invulnerability effect is only activated if the characters use an invulnerability skill, instead of if they become invulnerable from any source.
Uchiha Itachi (S)'s 'Mangekyou Overexertion' now properly increases the damage of 'Amaterasu Field'.
Kitsuchi (S)'s 'Earth Sandwich Jutsu' now properly changes the cost of 'Earth Rising Excavation Jutsu'.
Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S)'s 'Summoning: Mayhem' now properly increases the damage of Naruto's skills.
The Young Konan (S) test mission is no longer available.
Tsuchikage (S)'s 'Super-Weighted Boulder Technique' and 'Rock Fist' got new pictures due to a future update.
Tsunade (S)'s 'Enhanced Healing Wave' got a new name and picture due to a future update.
Yuhi Kurenai's 'Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death' no longer ends when Kurenai dies.
Sarutobi Konohamaru (S)'s 'Ash Pile Diversion' can now be normally countered and reflected.
The in-game text of Sarutobi Konohamaru (S)'s 'Shuriken Shadow Clone Barrage' no longer says that its triggered damage will only happen the turn after.
Partial Drain Effects now let you know if you successfully removed/stole chakra.
There's a new mission section called "Skin Missions".

Balances: 
Nerfs: Sarutobi Konohamaru (S), Edo Tensei Kakuzu (S), Young Konan (S).
Tweaks: Shinobi Alliance Neji (S).
Boosts: Omoi (S), Shinobi Alliance Kiba (S), Shinobi Alliance Shino (S), Edo Tensei Tayuya (S).

items.title: Major Update 2.1.1
items.body:
Hello everyone!
Today, it's time for a new major update! This update brings 6 new characters, 10 new character skins, 1 new profile border, and balance changes to keep the game fresh and exciting.
Get ready for new challenges, new strategies, and plenty of new content. 
See y'all soon!

New Skin Set: Released Sound Five - Unleash chaos on the battlefield with the Released Sound Five, breaking their limits and revealing their true power!

New Profile Border: Breaking Blood
New Skin Set: Akatsuki Recruits - Before they became legends, they had to prove their worth. Relive the battles that paved their way into the Akatsuki!

New Characters:

During the Fourth Great Ninja War, Tobi conceals his identity behind a white mask, wielding both the Sharingan and Rinnegan. Using the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path, he commands the resurrected jinchuuriki, while his Kamui allows him to evade attacks by rendering his body intangible.

Determined to follow in Naruto's footsteps, Konohamaru refuses to back down even against overwhelming opponents. Combining his shadow clones, clever distractions, and the powerful Rasengan, he fights to prove himself as a proud shinobi of the Hidden Leaf Village.

A blinded skill will target at random, instead of its original targets.

A skilled shinobi from the Hidden Cloud and a member of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces, Atsui specializes in Fire Release and swordsmanship. With his fiery personality and aggressive fighting style, he combines blazing sword techniques with powerful flames to overwhelm his enemies.

During the Fourth Great Ninja War, Neji fights alongside the Allied Shinobi Forces, using his mastery of the Byakugan and Gentle Fist to protect his comrades. Despite his chakra reserves gradually wearing thin, Neji remains determined to defend those he cares about.

Reanimated during the Fourth Shinobi World War, Chukichi was a renowned sensor from the Hidden Mist, capable of detecting even the faintest chakra signatures. Combining his exceptional sensory abilities with frost-based concealment and silent assassination techniques, he became a deadly threat on the battlefield.

Resurrected through the Edo Tensei, Kakuzu returns to the battlefield with his forbidden technique. Commanding multiple elemental hearts, he overwhelms his enemies with powerful ninjutsu while exploiting their life force to sustain his relentless assault.

Balances: 
Boosts: Senju Hashirama, Kitsuchi (S), Hidan (S), Kakuzu (S), Uchiha Itachi (S), Zetsu (S), Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S), Shinobi Alliance Sakura (S).
Nerfs: Shinobi Alliance Mei (S), Edo Tensei Deidara (S), Young Yahiko (S), Young Konan (S).

items.title: Major Update 2.0.8
items.body:
Hello everyone,
Today we're bringing 8 new characters and a small balance update to fix some characters that needed to be fixed.
See y'all guys soon!
New Characters:

Having surpassed Orochimaru and perfected Sage Transformation through relentless experimentation, Kabuto Yakushi has become a living nexus of stolen power. His body endlessly adapts, assimilating DNA, techniques, and chakra with surgical precision.

The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Yahiko is a stoic boy who leads his team in the fight for survival during the war.

The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Nagato is a quiet boy who is not only afraid of the world, but also afraid of himself.

The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Konan is a sweet girl who always cares more about her teammates than herself.

The leader of the original Akatsuki and one of the three Rain Orphans mentored by Jiraiya, Yahiko was a dear friend of Nagato and Konan and a highly idealistic person. Striving for world peace, Yahiko established the Akatsuki, leading them through the war-torn reality of their time with a 'kill or be killed' philosophy.

The legendary long-time leader of the Hidden Rain Village, Hanzo is a complicated man: unscrupulous and power-hungry, but at his core still seemingly a genuine believer in the ideal of universal peace. Having had a venom sac implanted in him as a child, Hanzo fights using poison and is deadly and ruthless in battle.

After his encounter with Kisame, in which the sentient weapon took a liking to his chakra, Killer Bee became the owner of the legendary Shark-Skin Blade, Samehada. With it at his side, Bee can use his arsenal of swords more efficiently, combining them with Samehada's ability to absorb chakra.

As the Fifth Mizukage, Mei Terumi joins the Allied Shinobi Forces during the Fourth Shinobi World War. Combining her mastery of Water Release with her corrosive kekkei genkai, she controls the battlefield while protecting the alliance.
Balances: 
Boosts: Uzumaki Kushina, Rock Lee.
Tweaks: Chiyo (S).
Nerfs: Hoshigaki Kisame (S), ET Sandaime Raikage (S), Edo Tensei Jinin (S), Hiruko Sasori (S).

items.title: Balance Update 2.0.4
items.body:
Hello everyone! Another week has gone by, which means it's time for a new update!
First of all, the three special characters, Mecha Naruto, Rock Lee (2014), and Uchiha Sasuke (Alternative), have been permanently disabled.
Note: If you completed the missions for any of these three characters, they will still appear in your character catalog, but you will only be able to use them in Private Games.
Additionally, we will be extending the duration of temporary missions to two weeks instead of just one, giving players who haven't completed them yet some extra time. We will follow this same format for future special characters.
And speaking of special characters, today we're bringing 3 more characters:

This is 2006-2008 version of Tenten, with improvements for her first skill.

This is 2007 version of Shikamaru.

This is 2006-2008 version of Haku.

This is a experimental version of Senju Hashirama.

Global Chat Updates
We've also brought some updates to the Global Chat:
The General Chat has been split into two separate channels: EN and PTBR.
System notifications have been added to the chat. You can now see messages where you've been mentioned.
Embedded links are now recognized by the interface.
Imgur URLs will now automatically be displayed as images attached to your message, with a limit of one image per message.
Attached images can now be expanded, with zoom-in and zoom-out functionality.
I hope this update brings something fun and useful for everyone, and we'll have more news to share soon!See you soon!

items.title: Balance Update 2.0.2 + New Characters
items.body:
Hello everyone,
                    
Today we're releasing Balance Update 2.0.2, bringing new character fixes and buffs, as well as nerfs to characters that have been dominating the Ladder over the past few weeks.
"As a note, so you guys understand how we operate. When it comes to changes like this (nerfs), we purposely take it slowly. We'd rather do 2 or 3 small changes than 1 giant one, because there is less chance of messing up and overnerfing a character. Despite this method taking a few days longer than otherwise, we do tend to prefer this method."
Also, for the next Major Update (August 15th), we will bring 3 new characters.
That's all, thank you all!

New Borders:

New Characters:

Dodai (S) is a skilled sensor shinobi and a lava release user as well. His intelligence is his most powerful asset and he will need it to survive this war.

Edo Tensei Rasa (S), the former Fourth Kazekage, has been summoned to participate in the war. Even after returning from death, he will prioritize his village above all else.

items.title: Balance Update 2.0.1
items.body:
Hello everyone,
                    
It's been one week, so we're back with another update, featuring a new Ladder Event, UI improvements, new features, and, of course, a Balance Update.

                    
Ladder Event

                    

                    We've added two temporary Ladder Missions, one featuring Fuuton Naruto (S) and another featuring Hebi Sasuke (S). Completing each mission will reward players with an exclusive Custom Rank designed for its featured character.

                    Both missions, along with the Ladder Event, will remain available until August 5, 2026. Once the temporary missions end, their Custom Rank rewards will no longer be obtainable.

                    Reminder: If you reset your account before completing a mission, all progress toward that mission will also be reset.

                    Custom Rank designs by ygorcavalcant.

                    
UI Improvements and New Features

                    The Selection screen has received a few improvements and now includes the following options:

                    
                        Profile Overview

                        Change Avatar

                        Reset Account

                    
                    These options can be accessed by clicking the Settings button.

                    We've also added a Settings button to the Battle screen, along with two new features:

                    
                        Opponent Profile Overview: View your opponent's profile and match history during a battle.

                        Auto-Reorder Skill Queue: Automatically reorganizes queued skills based on their priority.

                    
                    Note: Auto-Reorder Skill Queue is intended to help new and casual players, and it can be disabled at any time through the Battle settings.

                    
Balance Update

                    For this update, we first focused on nerfing characters that were overperforming and buffing characters that have been underperforming since the previous update. Our goal was to make each character better or more balanced where needed without forcing changes simply to shake up the Ladder.

                    The exceptions are Uzumaki Naruto (S) and Uchiha Sasuke (S), who received adjustments specifically for the new Ladder Event.

                    Additionally, now that Affliction is a main class, we'll be placing more focus on Affliction-class characters that still need balance adjustments, such as White Snake Kabuto (S) and Kankuro.

                    That's all for now! Another update is planned for August 5, 2026. See you then!

                
Balances: 
Nerfs: Hebi Sasuke (S), White Snake Kabuto (S), Shinobi Alliance Tenten (S), Fuuton Naruto (S), Kankuro.
Boosts: Uzumaki Naruto, Aburame Shino, Hyuuga Hinata, Hyuuga Neji, Gaara of the Desert.
Adjustments: Sai (S), Nara Shikamaru (S).
Event Boosts: Uzumaki Naruto (S), Uchiha Sasuke (S).
